title: Initial sourcing decision JSON
description: Required output structure. Integer quantities and dates are exact. Financial integers use the stated cents tolerance. Additional evidence/narrative fields are permitted and unscored.

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal year, 2027 through 2030. One row per year, sorted ascending; evaluation accepts reordered rows.

supplier_id.description: Stable supplier_id from the program. One row per candidate, sorted by supplier_id; evaluation accepts reordered rows.

base_terms_basis.description: Binding original or amended commercial state in this fiscal period. This describes dated applicability, not prices or document identifiers.

technical_admissible.description: True when the current assessment is qualified and covers both program variants; report outstanding actions separately. Capacity and launch feasibility belong in their own tables.

required_action_codes.description: Unordered unique action set. Normalize complete photometry validation to photometry_validation; crash validation to crash_validation; process audit to process_audit; unmatched required actions to other. Empty only when no required actions remain.
